title: Country Climate and Development Report: Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: Historical 2018 flood example; cocoa and climate projections for the 2050s
methodology: World Bank CCDR using sector analysis, climate projections and cited crop-suitability modelling.
limitations: Cocoa table cites an external model without a stated scenario.

title: Contribution Déterminée au niveau National 3.0 de la Côte d’Ivoire
temporal_coverage: Current vulnerability assessment and adaptation planning in NDC 3.0
methodology: Government NDC describing health, social and geographic climate vulnerabilities and planned adaptation measures.
limitations: The cited passages summarize diagnosis and plans; implementation outcomes are not assessed there.

title: The Climate Change and Conflict Nexus in West Africa: A New Approach for Operationally Relevant Vulnerability Assessments
temporal_coverage: Qualitative case study drawing on country literature and interviews; no single projection horizon
methodology: Qualitative Côte d’Ivoire case study triangulating literature, local and organizational reports, and semi-structured interviews.
limitations: Identifies potential risks, not causal attribution; findings are context-specific and some evidence is qualitative.
